thread:
maria.g: Quick heads-up — vendor roadmap sync w/ NVIDIA, AMD, and Habana TOMORROW 9am PT. Main asks: firm up H100/H200/B200 availability windows, MI300 distribution dates, Gaudi driver/revB timeline, and how that maps to marketplace onramp lanes + SI integration order.

oliver: Thanks. Can we also add a short item on announcement sequencing? press windows + embargoes.

sophie: +1. Need to know if any partner requires a 2-week embargo after driver cert before listing.

partner_ops_bot: Reminder: meeting scheduled 2025-05-08 09:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to vendor-liaisons and press-ops.

devon: FYI from infra: H100 capacity for Dedicated customers is currently projected to open 2025-06-15 (conservative). H200 is more queued — tentative late July.

ravi-plg: For hosted API, we'd like a soft onramp first (limited SLO customers) so we can validate batching and KV-cache behavior on Gaudi and MI300. Can partners provide early firmware/test images?

si-liaison: SI perspective: prefer this order for integrations: (1) H100/H200 primary, (2) MI300 integration with quantized pipelines, (3) Gaudi for lower-cost lanes. Reason: driver maturity + existing infra playbooks.

nisha: Press ops note — NVIDIA asked for a 10-day embargo from driver sign-off to joint announce last cycle. Is that a hard requirement?

oliver: Not sure it's hard, but it's their default. We should ask vendors to confirm. If they insist, we may need to stagger marketplace waves.

maria.g: Proposal: three waves — Wave A: H100 (invite list + early Dedicated), Wave B: MI300 + H200 (hosted + Dedicated open), Wave C: Gaudi + B200 lower-cost lane and wider marketplace. Each wave separated by ~3 weeks to absorb supply and cert issues. Thoughts?

devon: Sounds reasonable. Also add a "fallback lane" rule: if a vendor misses wave cutoff, auto-fallback to compatible model variant (e.g., H100 -> H200 family) for announcement copy and routing.

ravi-plg: Important: routing policy + cost controls must be baked in before Wave B for MI300. We saw a 30% token-cost delta in internal sim for MI300 quantized vs fp16. Need clear docs.

si-liaison: For SI onboarding, we need: canary AMIs/images, driver bundle, and an integration checklist. Example snippet we share with partners: `marketplace_onramp:
  wave: A
  canary_tag: gaudi-canary-2025
  driver_bundle: v2.1.0`

sophie: Can we include a short runbook entry in the meeting for "late-driver-breaks"? e.g., hold announcement, call vendor triage, enable fallback region.

maria.g: Yes — runbook item and owner assigned to partner-ops. Also request each vendor fill out a short form before the meeting: ETA for sign-off, embargo preference, a) any driver microcode caveats, b) known performance regressions vs our baseline.

partner_ops_bot: Form link: https://forms.redwood.example/vendor-onramp-2025 (auto-reminder in 12h).

nisha: PR cadence: If embargo >=7 days we can do staged comms: advanced blog post about marketplace features, then partner joint blog at announce. If embargo >14 days, need to coordinate legal review earlier.

oliver: Ops asks: ramping telemetry retention for initial waves — we want 30d metrics for the canary cohort to detect perf regressions. Can we commit storage?

devon: Yes, infra can allocate temporary extra storage for Wave A canaries. We'll add a cost estimate to the sheet.

ravi-plg: Question for vendors at the sync: can we get prebuilt quantized artifacts (int8/4bit) or at least export scripts? That reduces our onboarding time hugely.

maria.g: Good point. I'll add that to agenda. Also ask vendors to call out any cross-cloud image differences (Azure vs AWS vs Private).

si-liaison: One blocker: Habana (Gaudi) driver revB still has a known kernel panic under long-sequence streaming. Partner engineering said patch ETA mid-May. If that slips, Gaudi goes to Wave C only.

maria.g: Noted. We'll capture that in the meeting notes and make Wave assignment conditional on sign-off. For the sync, let's assign pre-reads: vendor compatibility matrix snapshot, canary runbook, press ops checklist, SI integration checklist.

oliver: Who will present the compatibility matrix? Ravi?

ravi-plg: I can take it. I'll upload a short PDF by EOD.

maria.g: Great. Final ask: if anyone cannot attend the 9am PT slot, please ping me — we'll do a 1:1 with that vendor after. Otherwise see you tomorrow. :calendar: :rocket:
